metric_definitions.baseline_rss_mb: psutil RSS of the target process (parent only), median of the 2 s before the scenario starts (after settle).
metric_definitions.peak_rss_mb: max psutil RSS of the target process over the scenario plus the 30 s settle window, sampled at 20 Hz.
metric_definitions.peak_children_rss_mb: max summed RSS of child processes (e.g. YOLO subprocess, celery beat child).
metric_definitions.peak_total_rss_mb: max of parent RSS + children RSS at one instant (the value the 6 GB watchdog compares).
metric_definitions.baseline_footprint_mb / peak_footprint_m: macOS phys_footprint from /usr/bin/footprint <pid> at ~1 Hz (includes compressed pages; RSS under-reports idle processes on macOS). settled = last sample 30 s after the scenario finished (API: after the last request; worker: after the pipeline drained).
metric_definitions.settled_footprint_delta_mb: settled_footprint_mb - baseline_footprint_mb (memory retained after the work).
metric_definitions.settled_rss_mb: median RSS over the last 3 s of the settle window (affected by the macOS memory compressor).
metric_definitions.wall_s: API scenarios: duration of the HTTP calls. Worker scenarios: first POST /content to the moment the pipeline is drained (items terminal, broker queue + unacked empty, worker CPU < 5 %), excluding the 10 s quiet-confirmation window.
metric_definitions.killed_at_mb: set if the 6 GB watchdog killed the process (a result, not a failure).
metric_definitions.worker baseline: worker scenarios first process one unmeasured 100KB article (warm-up: first-use imports), wait for drain + 10 s, then take the baseline.
